_about: The numbers the viewer still COMPUTES instead of reading verbatim from the event log or the content sheet. Each is a debt the engine owes as an event or a sheet field (THREE-PACKAGES-PLAN.md §8.3). This list may only SHRINK: verify.mjs fails if the source carries an 'EXEMPTION <name>' marker not listed here, or an entry here with no marker left in the source. Delete the entry the day the engine emits the number.

tick-projection.becomes: an engine event (tick.forecast, name provisional) emitted when a unit's statuses or protection change

dmg-fallback.computes: stat + bonus for a resting attack row before its damageOnHit has been seen
dmg-fallback.becomes: the sheet states the fields separately, or the engine emits the live figure

danger.computes: stat + bonus of the first attack for the danger marker
danger.becomes: an authored bestiary field, or the same live figure

move-range.computes: movement + budgetMod for a path/flight move's range
move-range.becomes: the sheet states the move's range; move.begin already carries the real budget

base-accuracy.computes: prints the sheet's BASE accuracy as the resting row's ACC
base-accuracy.becomes: the engine emits the live accuracy, or the row is labelled base

sheet.computes: resolves a unit's attack/ability/move ids to definitions
sheet.becomes: engine/src/content sheetOf(typeId), exported through both doors (plan §8.3 correction 1)
